risk_if_not_implemented: Without Temperature & Humidity Controls Monitoring, malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets (R-AM-1), Physical / Environmental Damage (R-SF-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to natural threats NT-1, NT-2, NT-3, NT-4, NT-5, NT-6, NT-8, NT-10, NT-11, NT-12, NT-13, NT-14; Utility Service Disruption (MT-7), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Hazardous / Degraded Operational Environment (MT-21), Product Defect / Design Failure (MT-23), Infrastructure Failure / Degradation (MT-27).

compensating_control_1.name: Supporting Utilities
compensating_control_1.description: Facility security mechanisms exist to protect power equipment and power cabling for the system from damage and destruction.
compensating_control_1.justification: Supporting Utilities (PES-20) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Temperature & Humidity Controls (PES-29) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Facility applicability. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Temperature & Humidity Controls (PES-29) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
